teks.Docking kovalen memakai metode tethered: Covalent docking uses the tethered method (flexible side chain): ligand is chemically reacted with the target residue side chain to form an adduct, aligned along the residue CA-CB axis, and docked as a single flexible residue (AutoDock-GPU --flexres) against the sidechain-truncated receptor. Reported score represents adduct-receptor energy, not binding ΔG, and is comparable only among covalent ligands at the same target residue.
teks.Kewajaran fisik pose terbaik tiap ligan: Physical plausibility of each ligand's top pose (chemistry, bond geometry, ring planarity, internal energy, protein clashes) evaluated using PoseBusters (dock configuration).
teks.Pose terbaik disempurnakan dengan OpenM: Top poses refined using OpenMM: Amber ff14SB for protein, OpenFF Sage 2.3 for ligands with OpenFF NAGL partial charges (AM1-BCC equivalent), Li/Merz nonbonded parameters for metal ions. Complexes minimized in implicit solvent OBC2 (protein heavy atoms restrained at 5 kcal/mol/Å²) and/or simulated (Langevin MD 300 K, 2 fs timestep, constrained H-bonds; optional explicit TIP3P with PME and 0.15 M NaCl). MM/GBSA ΔG calculated via single-trajectory protocol (OBC2, igb = 5, mbondi2 radii, ACE surface term) without conformational entropy.
teks.Sifat fisikokimia dan kemiripan obat di: Physicochemical and drug-likeness descriptors computed via RDKit from neutral forms (Wildman-Crippen WLOGP, Ertl TPSA); Lipinski, Veber, Ghose, Egan, and Muegge filters; PAINS alerts; gastrointestinal absorption and blood-brain barrier permeability predicted using BOILED-Egg model.
